enabled.description: Enable the CalDAV plugin. If false, the plugin will not load.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Only recommended for troubleshooting.

server_url.description: Base URL of the CalDAV server (e.g., https://caldav.example.com/dav/user/). Required if not using auto-discovery.

username.description: User identifier for authentication (often email address). Not used for OAuth2.

display_name.description: Human-readable account name shown in the UI. Falls back to username if omitted.

use_ssl.description: Require encrypted (TLS/SSL) connections to the server.

verify_ssl.description: Verify server certificate chain and hostname. Disable only for self-signed certs (not recommended).

sync_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic sync attempts (minimum: 60).

timeout.description: Connection and request timeout in seconds.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed sync attempts.

caldav_path.description: Optional override for CalDAV path if server uses a non-standard endpoint.

supports_vcards.description: Set to false if the server does not support CardDAV (vCards) for contacts.

supports_events.description: Set to false to disable calendar event synchronization.

supports_tasks.description: Enable task/ToDo synchronization (server must support Tasks extension).

calendars.description: List of CalDAV calendars to automatically subscribe to during setup.

name.description: Friendly name for the calendar (shown in UI)

readonly.description: If true, sync only downloads changes; user cannot submit updates
